title: Can I BEAT the Rosen Score?
summary: First Rosen Score video: the Rosen Score site awards trophies for Eric Rosen-inspired challenges (he starts 22/63). Challenge: Alphabet Openings - win a game whose opening moves spell a word using the files of the moves. In the public blitz pool vs ~2000-2150 humans he spells and wins 'CHAD' (c-, h-, a-, d-file moves) and, after misspelling once, spells and wins 'HEADACHE' (ending with a surprise rook mate).
rules: Normal chess (rated public blitz pool at his true rating).
Alphabet opening: your first moves must be to/with files spelling the word in order (CHAD = c, h, a, d; HEADACHE = h, e, a, d, a, c, h, e); then play freely.
win_condition: Spell the word with your first moves and win the game.

opponent.name: Online humans ~2000-2150 (e.g. PURESATURDAYY ~2039)
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com default avatars; Rosen Score list of named openings (Egg, Bad Egg, Beef, Van 't Kruijs).

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board; Rosen Score website challenge list.

setup: Standard start; target word CHAD then HEADACHE.
